items.title: Phase/fixed domains
items.content: Source R^d×R^d; fixed y/reference/z0, finite t>=0. Coordinate-free finiteBorel E/rank0 is ASTIS packaging, not a new regularity assumption.

items.title: Original six hypotheses
items.content: 0<alpha<=beta; C2V; globalboth Hessianbounds; eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Retain all six original binders even if first-event subproof uses fewer.

items.title: Literal dynamics
items.content: Harmonic actualPhi centered at y-eta gradV(reference), totalstate-dependentmomentumreflection withR0=I, lambda=sqrteta max(0,<p,gradV(x)-gradV(r)>). No supplied measurable surrogate.

items.title: Actual clocks
items.content: Independent Exp1, source E_(n+1); ASTIS actual countableproduct/zeroindex supportprojection adapter. Independence is for unused clocks versus past, not arbitrary random states correlated with the same clocks.

items.title: Hazard/wait
items.content: Lambda_z(u)=integral_0^u lambda(Phi_s z)ds; tau=inf{u>=0:Lambda>=e}, empty∞. Flat hazards and infinite waits allowed; no positive/invertible rate assumption.

items.title: Initialization/stopping
items.content: Live initial record(0,z0), finitewait postbounceupdate; absorbing stoppedalternative carriesno phase. Lastlive infinitewait continuesfreeflow at every finite horizon.

items.title: Half-open boundary
items.content: Live arcs [T_n,T_(n+1)); jumpstate postbounce. Rawzero thresholds may zero-wait but actualExp1 strictlypositive AE; no samplewise source initialization across invalid samples.

items.title: Energy/ratecap
items.content: H=.5(eta^-1||x-c||²+||p||²), fixedinitialE conserved; rate bounded by L_E=sqrteta beta sqrt(2E)(sqrt(2etaE)+||c-r||). Zero cap no-jump case distinct.

items.title: Nonexplosion
items.content: Positivecap finite waits>=Eclock/L; continuing recursion SLLN forcesT_n∞. Stopping is separate. Source Expmean route versus ASTIS boundedindicator sufficient alternative remain distinct, no reproving here.

items.title: Joint measurable law context
items.content: Source jointly Borel recursion/terminalpi; ASTIS joint allfinite Z/K is an adapter. Source failedlimit0 differs from uncoveredinitialz; fixedparameter AE lawcompatibility only, no uniformAE/correlated substitution.

items.title: Hazard differentiability
items.content: Literal free-arc rate is continuous/nonnegative; Lambda(0)=0, C1 derivative lambda(Phi_u z), nondecreasing, locally bounded. Derive from source data, not added premise.

items.title: Finite first-event CDF
items.content: For finite t: P(tau(epsilon0)<=t)=1-exp(-Lambda_z(t)); no finite atoms. Strict/nonstrict endpoints agree AE, including t0. This is only prospective and must be checked for duplicate producers after freeze.

items.title: Finite first-event density
items.content: On finite s>=0, densitylambda(Phi_s z)exp(-Lambda_z(s))ds for actual firstwait, marked by actualpostbounceS(Phi_s z). Mass at∞ is omitted by finitehorizon restriction; no phase∞ ever evaluated.

items.title: Single-edge candidate consumer
items.content: For fixed finite t and bounded Borel h(time,phase), actual firstevent integral restricted0<tau<=t equals integral_0^t h(s,S(Phi_s z))lambda(Phi_s z)exp(-Lambda_z(s))ds. This feeds iterated A7 jumpfactor, not just restated measurability.

items.title: First-event law backgrounds
items.content: CDF measure uniqueness plus density from C1 cumulative derivative OR monotone-hazard transport of Exp1. Exact library contracts must be found/derived; flat hazards invalidate a naive differentiable inverse argument.

items.title: Unused-tail conditioning
items.content: Exp product prefix/tail factorization or equivalent conditional disintegration must derive futureindependence after past-dependent firstwait/poststate. Pointwise fixedstate AE cannot simply substitute correlated randomstate; no Markov assumption as shortcut.

items.title: Ordered times simplex
items.content: Delta_n(t)={0<t1<...<tn<t}; finite orderedstrict times. Delta0 singletonemptytuple with0dimvolume1; t0 and n>0 empty. Endpoint t events must be null via event-time law, not silently discarded.

items.title: Prescribed deterministic path
items.content: Given z0 andorderedtimes, finite alternatingPhi andS, postjump at t_j and prejumpPhi segmentlimit. No unspecified pathspace topology required for marked/endpoint consumers.

items.title: A7 weights
items.content: n-event weight exp(-integral_0^t lambda(path_s)ds) product_jlambda(path_(t_j)-). Sum of boundedpathfunctional over simplex integrals equals actualexpectation; firsteventproducer alone doesnot prove this.

items.title: Residual survival
items.content: After lastprescribedjump, no-next-event before remaining horizon contributes exp(-residualhazard). Requires unusedclocklaw with derived conditioning; infinite nextwait naturally included.

items.title: Simplex volume/summability
items.content: For each fixed initialenergy, |Delta_n(t)|=t^n/n!, absolute term<=||Psi||∞(L_E t)^n/n!, hence absolute convergence. General finiteE includingrank0/time0 conventions explicit.

items.title: No global expcap envelope
items.content: L_E depends on initialstate. Do not assume exp(L_E*t) integrable undernu for everyt or add exponentialmoment premise. Nonnegative A7 withPsi1 gives total mass1; Tonelli plus boundedtest gives integratedabsolute bound instead.

items.title: Exact phase density
items.content: q_y exactGibbs quadratictilt timesstandardGaussian; rho(z)=exp(-V_y(x)-||p||²/2), positive, normalizednu proportionalrho. Normalization distinctfrominvariance; densitynormalizer cancels in localidentity.

items.title: Momentum reversal identities
items.content: R(x,p)=(x,-p), R Phi_t R=Phi_-t, R S=S R; S involutionincludingzero-normal, rateforwardpre=rate(R forwardpost). No continuityofS needed.

items.title: A4 derivative
items.content: d/ds log rho(Phi_s z)=-(lambda(Phi_s z)-lambda(RPhi_s z)); source C2 and actualODE suffice; do not supply densityevolution as publicpremise.

items.title: A6 volume preservation
items.content: Flow/R preserve Lebesgue; state-dependentS via Fubini and orthogonalreflection on eachmomentumslice. Establish Borel measurepreservingbijections; do not assert S differentiable/continuous.

items.title: A8 domain map
items.content: (z0,t1..tn)->(Rz_t,t-tn..t-t1). Timecoordinate map determinantabs1 preservesDelta_n(t); forfixedtimes endpointcomposition is Borelmeasurepreservingbijection.

items.title: Skew reversal proof
items.content: To get full productdomainchange use measurabledependence ontime and fiberwise statepreservation plusFubini/Tonelli; fixedtimevolume preservation alone not a silently supplied fullproduct bijection assumption.

items.title: Jump-value convention gap
items.content: Literal s->R path_(t-s) of a rightcontinuous path is leftcontinuous at jumps. Finiteorderedtime endpoint/prejump proof must use matching one-sided states or equalityawayfromjumptimes; arbitrarypathfunctional law needs explicit path sigma-algebra/reversal convention. Do not silently call it fullcadlag law.

items.title: Bounce preserves Gibbs density
items.content: Position unchanged and momentum normpreserved, so rho(Sz)=rho(z); combined with volume preservation givesnuS-invariance. Separate from fullphase processinvariance.

items.title: Finite-path survival identity
items.content: rho(z0)e^-forwardhazard=rho(z_t)e^-reversedratehazard; sumintegrated A4 on eachfree arc and bounce rho invariance. No unproved stationaryprocess premise.

items.title: Jump factor matching
items.content: Forward prejump and reversedprejump=Rforwardpost matchrates at eachjump. Zerofactor/trivial-prescribedjumps do not require a positive-rate binder.

items.title: Termwise weighted reversal
items.content: Requires productdomain Borel changevariables AND survival-density equality AND everyjumpfactor AND actualn-eventlaw. Neither algebraicpattern nor kernel existence suffices.

items.title: Signed endpoint tests
items.content: For boundedBorel F,G, integrateF(z)T_tG(z)dnu=integrate(RG)(z)T_t(RF)(z)dnu. Tonelli fornonnegative then fourpositive/negative terms or absoluteintegrability fromfiniteprobability.

items.title: Invariance F1
items.content: SetF1, useR-preservation andT_t1=1 toderiveactualnu invariance; q/nu normalizationalone orKprobability isinsufficient.

items.title: L2 obligations
items.content: Trueinvariance yieldsAE-safeoperator/Jensencontractivity; boundedC_c zero-limit plusindependentC_cdensity extendallL2. C_b previousASTISsubclass extension is notallL2 andnotnew target here.

items.title: Restart separate
items.content: Source memorylessness statement needsactualfutureconditionalargument forprocessMarkov/CK/semigroup. Firsteventdensity isnotfullrestart, norfullA7or invar.

items.title: Generator shortcut rejected
items.content: Do not exponentiate formaladjoint withoutgenerator/domain/semigroup theorem; sourceitself rejectsnaiveargument dueSdiscontinuity.

items.title: Global scope/cost/license
items.content: No newSAU/header/Lean/proofsearch/compile/state/formalizedlabel. Existingfourpaper priority remainsPBPSthenSPHMCactualcompositionthenGaussianCloudthenmidpoint. Noexpectedquerycost/hypocoercivity/main orwholeGoal credit.

items.title: Atomic flow/bounce introduction
items.content: Explicit harmonic flow and bounce definitions are the ones already represented at Ex2/Ex3.

items.title: Atomic zero-normal explanation
items.content: Bounce is involutive; possible zero-normal discontinuity does not introduce an actual jump because the rate vanishes there.

items.title: Atomic momentum-reversal introduction
items.content: Define state momentum reversal and its observable pullback.

items.title: Atomic phase-density introduction
items.content: Use the same notation for phase law and its Lebesgue density.

items.title: Complete operator proposition statement and three consequence clauses
items.content: For each nonnegative time, adjoint equals momentum-reversed operator; phase invariance, strongly continuous L2 contraction semigroup, and Gaussian-averaged self-adjoint Markov contraction. A first finite-event theorem closes none of these complete source conclusions.

items.title: Each formal-generator heuristic region is explicitly excluded as a rigorous proof route
items.reason: The source explicitly labels the generator/adjoint/exponentiation calculation heuristic because the bounce map can be discontinuous. Preserve it as source exposition, but do not admit its formal exponentiation as a proof of semigroup adjointness or invariance.
items.content: Formal drift/jump split, log-density action, integration by parts, bounce change of variables, adjoint sum, exponentiation and momentum-average observation remain heuristic.

items.title: Final Gaussian momentum averaging proof
items.content: Gaussian averaging satisfies R Pi_p*=Pi_p* and Pi_p R=Pi_p. Using the full L2 adjoint reversal A3 gives (Pi_p T_t Pi_p*)*=Pi_p T_t Pi_p*. Markov and contraction properties are inherited. This remains OPEN beyond the first-event law.

source_gaps: Pathfunctional measurable space and right/left jumpvalue reversal convention are not explicitly formalized by source. Marked firstevent/endpoint consumers avoid inventing a fullpathspace theorem.
Global outerintegrability cannot be inferred from state-dependent exp(ratecap*t) bound; use positive A7massone/Tonelli before signed interchange.
Authors say iterating clocks for A7; actual conditional prefix/tail and firstevent density are mathematical ingredients to derive, never convenience theorem binders.
